rules.title: Broker fee paid only by the party who engaged the broker
rules.requirement: A licensed broker or salesperson may contract solely with a prospective tenant or solely with a landlord or landlord's agent. Any fee may be paid only by the party (lessor or tenant) who originally engaged and contracted with the broker or salesperson.
rules.coverage_text: Fees charged by licensed brokers or salespersons who find rental residential real property for prospective tenants or find tenants for landlords.
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
